central_object: Learn reusable procedural behavior together with scope-, evidence-, authority-, policy-, version- and verifier-sensitive warrant sufficient for held-out use and later retain/revalidate/retract/abstain decisions.

natural_class.name: Warranted Parity Learning with distinct scoped proof paths
natural_class.warrant_semantics: a prediction is warranted iff its query vector lies in the row span of surviving scope-valid certified equations
natural_class.positive_certificate: lambda with lambda^T A=x and lambda^T b=y
natural_class.negative_certificate: v with A v=0 and x dot v=1
natural_class.backup_path: after revoking P_i=e_i, a scoped equation e_i+e_s plus surviving P_s re-derives e_i
natural_class.equal_architecture_boundary: an equally provisioned recurrent/looped Transformer can implement the finite algorithm

best_current_residual.name: Natural-Class Warrant Compilation Frontier
